_README: SIMULATOR evidence for B0-09 (HLT-IOS-*). NOT physical-device evidence: per spikes/evidence/templates, simulator files never count toward PASS. Deliberately NOT placed in spikes/evidence/ so evidence_judge cannot ingest it.
test_data: One obviously fake medication 'ZZ Fakemed Test' (Tablet, daily 10:25 PM) and one fake Taken log, created by hand in the simulator Health app. No real data.

HLT-IOS-01.denied_or_ungranted_vs_empty: With one medication present in Health, an ungranted/denied app got 'medication query OK: 0 medication(s)' and 'dose-event query OK: 0 event(s)' with no error, indistinguishable from a user with no medications (run2, run3).
HLT-IOS-01.authorizationStatus_for_dose_event: returned 2 (sharingAuthorized) before any grant; it is a write-status API and is not a read-denial signal

HLT-IOS-02.details: requestPerObjectReadAuthorization(userAnnotatedMedicationType) shows 'Medications Access' sheet listing the fake medication with a toggle and our NSHealthShareUsageDescription text (evidence 02, 05, 08). After granting: medication query returned 1 medication (displayText, isArchived=false, hasSchedule=true); dose query returned 1 event logStatus=4 (taken) scheduleType=2 (schedule) (run4, evidence 09-11).
HLT-IOS-02.dose_events_authorized_via: the medication per-object grant: requestPerObjectReadAuthorization and requestAuthorization(read:) both raise NSInvalidArgumentException for the dose-event type itself
HLT-IOS-02.taken_claim_shown_as_unverified_external: not applicable to a log-only spike app; no ledger exists in the spike

HLT-IOS-03.simulator_status: OBSERVED: write not possible (record OS result)
HLT-IOS-03.result: requestAuthorization(toShare:[medicationDoseEventType], read:[]) raised uncaught NSInvalidArgumentException: 'Authorization to share the following types is disallowed: HKMedicationDoseEventTypeIdentifierMedicationDoseEvent' (run-write-probe-console.txt). HKMedicationDoseEvent.init is NS_UNAVAILABLE in the SDK headers. This is the simulator OS result; confirm on a physical device.

HLT-IOS-04.note: Revocation while running, deleted source data and locked-device read failure were not exercised. Only observed: uninstalling/reinstalling the spike app reset its grant (prompt reappeared), and after an explicit Don't Allow a repeat requestPerObjectReadAuthorization returned OK with no sheet (evidence 06).
